about_the_game:
Psychological horror experience where exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling guide you through a decaying world full of secrets best left buried. What was meant to be just another exploration quickly unravels into something far more disturbing.

With only your instincts and your resolve, you’ll need to push forward, and piece together what really happened beneath the surface.

  • Immersive First-Person Exploration: Navigate unsettling spaces with realistic environmental detail and atmosphere driven horror.

  • Environmental Storytelling: Clues, letters, and hidden visuals build a deeper mystery across the environment.

  • Subtle Puzzle & Interaction Design: Progress by observing your environment, using key items, and paying attention to what others missed.

  • Demo Built for Tension: The demo includes the early stage of the game. a taste of some puzzles, interactions, story, creeping dread and discovery. So you can experience what the game is about.

content_descriptors.notes: Not suitable for people sensitive to themes of horror, fear.
